title: 2 Data Center Stocks That Could Help Make You a Fortune
author: John Ballard
description: As hyperscalers invest heavily in data center infrastructure to support AI services, with Morgan Stanley projecting $1.4 trillion in capital spending by 2028, two data center stocks offer attractive valuations: Iren, which is building an AI cloud platform with vertically integrated capabilities and targeting $4 billion revenue by 2026, and Vertiv, which supplies power management and cooling systems to data centers with projected 20-22% annual revenue growth through 2030.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is positioned as a leading AI cloud infrastructure provider with vertically integrated assets (land, power, construction), strong revenue growth trajectory ($1B to $4B by 2026), validated execution capability through Microsoft delivery, and analyst projections showing $10.7B adjusted operating profit by 2029 against $19B enterprise value, suggesting undervaluation.

Company benefits from increasing power demands in data centers with 24% YoY revenue growth, 22%+ operating margins, and management raising long-term guidance to 20-22% annual revenue growth through 2030. Wall Street expects 38% annualized earnings growth, and the company's end-to-end product portfolio deepens customer relationships.
Mentioned as a customer of Iren with a $9.7 billion five-year data center deal, indicating strong AI infrastructure investment but not the primary focus of the article.

title: Can AI Data Center Demand Drive nVent Electric's Growth in 2026?
author: Na
description: nVent Electric reported 53% sales growth in Q2 2026, driven by surging AI data center demand. The company raised its 2026 guidance to 37-39% sales growth and expects data center sales to exceed $2 billion. Strong demand for liquid cooling solutions prompted the company to announce a second facility (Blaine 2) opening in 2027. The company faces competition from Vertiv and Super Micro Computer in the AI infrastructure space.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong 53% YoY sales growth, raised 2026 guidance significantly (37-39% from 26-28%), expanding capacity with new Blaine 2 facility, benefiting from accelerating AI-related data center spending, and maintains Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

Also benefiting from strong AI data center spending with broad power and thermal management portfolio, expanding liquid-cooling capabilities through acquisitions, and expects 2026 sales growth of 37% YoY with 31% organic growth.

Strong player in AI data-center infrastructure with comprehensive solutions spanning servers, storage, networking and direct liquid cooling, expanding manufacturing capacity to support 3,000+ direct liquid-cooled racks monthly, and expects significant fiscal 2027 revenue growth ($65-72 billion).

title: Vertiv Holdings Co. (VRT) Stock Moves 1.04%: What You Should Know
author: Na
description: Vertiv Holdings Co. (VRT) closed at $253.46, up 1.04%, but underperformed its sector over the past month. Analysts expect strong earnings growth of 47.58% YoY with revenue projected at $3.77 billion (+40.79% YoY). The company holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, though it trades at a premium Forward P/E of 37.51 compared to its industry average of 13.48.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong expected earnings growth of 47.58% YoY and revenue growth of 40.79% YoY support positive outlook. Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating and recent positive estimate revisions (+0.88% over 30 days) indicate analyst optimism. However, premium valuation (Forward P/E of 37.51 vs. industry average of 13.48) and recent underperformance relative to sector temper the sentiment slightly.

title: Eaton vs. Vertiv: Which Data Center Power Stock Has an Edge?
author: Na
description: As AI drives data center expansion, both Eaton Corporation and Vertiv are positioned to benefit from increased demand for power and cooling infrastructure. Vertiv has a stronger edge with higher growth estimates (37% revenue growth, 60% EPS growth for 2026), a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, and a VGM Score of A, while Eaton carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) and VGM Score of D. However, Vertiv trades at a higher valuation (30.1X forward P/E) compared to Eaton (28.45X).

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong growth projections (37% revenue growth, 60% EPS growth for 2026), Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), VGM Score of A, strategic acquisitions in liquid cooling, margin expansion guidance, and positive analyst sentiment support sustained growth in AI infrastructure demand.

Solid fundamentals with exposure to data center expansion, grid modernization, and industrial automation, supported by $3B R&D investment and $1B+ capacity expansion. However, lower growth estimates (19% revenue growth, 12.2% EPS growth for 2026), Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), and VGM Score of D indicate a more conservative outlook compared to Vertiv.

title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights NVIDIA, Vertiv, Arista Networks, Broadcom and Hewlett Packard
author: Zacks Equity Research
description: As AI data centers expand, investment opportunities extend beyond GPU chips to infrastructure providers. Vertiv and Arista Networks are highlighted as beneficiaries of rising demand for power, cooling, and high-speed networking solutions supporting AI workloads. Vertiv has seen recent stock pullback despite strong fundamentals, while Arista continues gaining momentum with robust AI networking demand.
